subject: Wave 12 closure integrity repair — truthful taskcard update

repair_summary.deferred_reason: Prerequisite HTTP URL verification was not performed in Wave 12. No URLs were confirmed via HTTP GET. Task deferred to Wave 13 Lane C.

evidence_audit.method: Disk file existence check for each taskcard deliverable
evidence_audit.not_on_disk_reason: URL registry upgrade was contingent on HTTP verification which was not done

root_cause: Wave 12 taskcards were defined at Lane 0 with initial status PENDING and were never updated as work progressed through Lanes A-J. The IV script (IV-02) only verified that the taskcards.json file existed on disk — it did not read and count taskcard statuses. The adversarial review checked policy text but did not recompute status counts from disk. These gaps allowed the sprint to claim SPRINT_COMPLETE despite 47/53 taskcards remaining PENDING.
wave13_repairs_applied: IV script hardened: Lane B will add explicit check that all current-sprint taskcards are COMPLETE
Adversarial review hardened: Lane B will add disk-read status count verification
BMV sidecar protocol: Lane B will implement external .sha256 sidecar (not inside ZIP)
W12-LD-06 deferred: Wave 13 Lane C will perform actual HTTP verification
